title: Fake multisig keys
note: This row marks a CHECKMULTISIG with more 33-byte keys than the slider. The slider starts at 10, which is Knots' line, and it cannot be set higher. A lower number marks more. A 2-of-3 stays out at 10. It does not see a key that is not in that multisig, or a 32-byte tapscript key. Those are SFS-32, which is off.
